crm_notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics platform (in-app insights + support search). Currently on another LLM API provider for embeddings + chat (heavy use of reranking). Evaluating Redwood Hosted as drop-in replacement then Dedicated for production.

Highlights from calls: 
- "Customer quote": "We need parity with current prompts and output distributions — any drift is a showstopper."
- Cost sensitivity: aiming to reduce per-1000-token unit cost by ~20% after Dedicated buy.
- Ops: prefer VPC peering, customer-managed KMS for PII tokens.

Technical notes / POC plan: 
- Phase A (Hosted): 2-week POC. Import current OpenAPI-style prompts through compatibility shim. Validate prompt parity on 150 golden queries, run automated regression harness (extant evals in Drive). Measure latency p50/p95 and token costs.
- Phase B (Dedicated): sizing call to estimate reserved capacity + burst headroom. Expect steady-state: ~200 qps for short chat queries, embeddings batch of 200 requests/hour, ~100k tokens/day. Latency target: p50 < 180ms, p95 < 400ms for chat endpoint. Throughput target: sustained 1500 tps batching on dedicated pools.
- Compatibility: described need for API compatibility layer (OpenAI-compat shim) + tooling to translate existing system prompts and function-calling hooks. SE Diego demo'd Redwood compatibility flags and "translate-prompts" helper; initial translation had 3/150 failures (formatting/parsing differences).
- Quality monitoring: want eval alerts on regressions tied to golden prompt set; prefer integration with existing QA dashboard.

Risks called out: 
- Prompt parity regressions (semantic shifts) — customer will run A/B tests; failing parity increases legal/regulatory risk for generated content.
- Procurement timeline: legal insists on SLA wording around data residency (EU customers) and access logs.

Stated wins from demos so far: Hosted API demo returned matching reranking results in 120/150 golden queries; p50 observed 120ms in us-west for single-turn chat with Redwood-hosted base model. SE notes: caching and KV-prefix reuse reduced token spend ~8% in initial runs.

Open actionables: 
- Provide detailed cost model for Dedicated (reserved + burst) by 2026-03-08 (owner: Priya).
- Deliver regression report (150 queries) with diffs and suggested prompt adjustments (owner: Diego) by 2026-03-05.
- Security packet (SAML + KMS diagrams, SOC2 evidence) uploaded to Drive and shared with InfoSec (owner: Naomi).
